task.title: Update Inventory Stock
task.shortdesc: Update the available stock quantity for a product at a branch.

context.p: Store managers can update inventory quantities for products assigned to their branches.
Cashiers can view inventory information but cannot update stock quantities.

step.cmd: Select the product and branch whose stock you want to update.

taskbody.result:
The inventory quantity is updated for the selected product and branch.
If the updated quantity is at or below the configured minimum stock level, the product may be identified as low stock.
For endpoint details, see
Inventory API Reference
